facts.note: Rosa states the kitchen clock is a quarter of an hour fast and that she keeps it so on purpose so nothing is late; she repeats 'A quarter and no more.'
Lina came down to the kitchen at thirteen minutes to eleven by the kitchen clock and stayed until after the temple struck eleven.
The piano began at two minutes to eleven by the kitchen clock and stopped at eleven minutes past eleven by the kitchen clock.
The hall clock struck eleven when the kitchen clock showed thirteen minutes past eleven.

added.quote: She had been working up in the atelier with the master, and then he sent her down, and she came to me to be near someone.
added.why: Places Lina in the atelier with the master before she came down at 10:47 by the kitchen clock, and orders that stay before her descent. A detective gets a whereabouts for Lina and a sequence: atelier first, kitchen after.
